name: Current regime
derivation: Train breadth is 0.0 through 0.9 in steps of 0.1, ten values. Nearest-rank at 1/3 takes index round(0.3333 * 9) = round(3.0) = 3, giving 0.3; at 2/3 index round(0.6667 * 9) = round(6.0) = 6, giving 0.6. So LOW is <= 0.3, HIGH is > 0.6, MID is between. The queries walk one value into each band plus both boundaries: 0.3 is LOW (<=) and 0.6 is MID (not >).
note: expected is the fitted cuts first (breadth then volatility), then one label per query
